BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO:

SECTION 1. Title 17 of the Municipal Code of Chicago, the Chicago Zoning Ordinance, is hereby
amended by changing all the B3-1 Community Shopping District symbols and indications as shown on
Map No. 8-J in the area bounded by:

West 38" Street; South Kedzie Avenue; a line 24.0 feet south of and parallel to West 38h
Street; and the alley next west of and parallel to South Kedzie Avenue.

to those of a B3-2 Community Shopping District.

SECTION 2. This Ordinance shall be in force and effect from and after its passage and due publication.

Common Property Address: 3800 South Kedzie Avenue
